unit: Unit 13: Making Your Computer Easier to Use
title: Turning it all back off
drDigitalIntro:
The single biggest reason people never try these settings is the fear of not being able to undo them.
• Every switch in this unit is a switch. Clicking it a second time puts things back.
• Even Invert Colors, which changes the screen most dramatically, is undone by the same control that turned it on.
• If a change makes the screen hard to read, the setting you need is still in the same place — it just looks different.
• In this activity the screen starts inverted and grayscale. Put it back to normal.

playgroundTask.goal: You put the screen back to normal

steps.say: Click Accessibility in the list on the left.
Turn Invert Colors on, so the screen flips.
Now click the same switch again to turn it back off.
Now click Off to bring the color back.

drDigitalSuccess: Nothing you change here is permanent. That is worth remembering the next time you are tempted not to try something.
drDigitalHint: The control that made the change is the control that undoes it — the same switch, the same place.
